..rationale: Ruff configured in pyproject.toml [tool.ruff.lint] (E,W,F,I,B,C4,UP), run by the local-ruff-check pre-commit hook and scripts/lint.sh
ruff format runs in the local-ruff-format pre-commit hook and scripts/format.sh; black is only a docs dependency
Ruff selects no pep8-naming (N) rules and the only in-repo contributing doc (docs/en/docs/contributing.md, 7 lines) links off-repo to tiangolo.com; no committed naming rules
C901 is explicitly in [tool.ruff.lint] ignore ("too complex"); no other complexity limit
No import-linter or other boundary tooling; underscore-private modules (fastapi/_compat, fastapi/telemetry/_*.py) are convention only
README only covers end-user install (uv add fastapi, uv run fastapi dev), but dev commands are exposed as scripts/test.sh, scripts/lint.sh, scripts/format.sh plus uv.lock and dependency-groups

scripts/test.sh runs `pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/` non-interactively with no credentials (CI calls it via test-cov.sh); README does not document it, contrary to the scanner, whose match was a feature-list mention of pytest
No in-repo doc shows running one test; scripts/test.sh forwards ${@} so `bash scripts/test.sh tests/test_x.py::test_y` would work, but nothing says so

single_command_setup.rationale: No setup script, Makefile or justfile target and no committed doc naming a bootstrap command; `uv sync` + `prek install` must be inferred from pyproject.toml and CI YAML

agentic_development.rationale: Commit 4f0152c (#15930, 2026-07-28) carries `Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>` (outside the scanner's 300-commit window), and translate.yml runs a pydantic-ai Agent (scripts/translate.py) on a schedule that opens PRs via pr-submit[bot], e.g. #16497-#16501

automated_pr_review.rationale: codspeed[bot] posts performance reports on PRs (e.g. #16643, #16642), guard-dependencies.yml comments and auto-closes non-member dependency PRs, detect-conflicts.yml comments on conflicts

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: Test workflow on pull_request: median 6.2 min, max 9.95 min over the last 20 completed runs (gh run list)

dead_feature_flag_detection.rationale: No feature flag system; the library is published to PyPI with no deployed app

..rationale: tests/test_tutorial/* (77 dirs) drive full docs_src apps through TestClient incl. SQLModel+SQLite and GraphQL; tests/test_telemetry/test_integrations.py runs real OTel SDK integrations in subprocesses against a local OTLP HTTP collector (_otlp.py)
coverage-combine job in test.yml runs `coverage report --fail-under=100` and smokeshow.yml publishes coverage status on PRs
Library with no web UI of its own; scripts/playwright only captures docs screenshots

skills.rationale: Only fastapi/.agents/skills/fastapi/SKILL.md, package data teaching end users' agents to write FastAPI apps, not a harness-discovered root skill for working on this repo

service_flow_documented.rationale: English docs carry mermaid sequence diagrams of request and dependency flows (docs/en/docs/tutorial/dependencies/dependencies-with-yield.md, advanced/behind-a-proxy.md); no internal ARCHITECTURE.md

automated_doc_generation.rationale: 22 pages in docs/en/docs/reference/ use mkdocstrings `::: fastapi.*` directives, built by build-docs.yml on every PR and deployed by deploy-docs.yml

..rationale: All env vars the library reads are optional and documented: FASTAPI_OTEL_AUTO_CONFIGURE/OTEL_* in docs/en/docs/advanced/opentelemetry.md, FASTAPI_ENV in docs/en/docs/fastapi-cli.md; none are needed to develop or test

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: .gitignore has env/venv/dist/.idea/.DS_Store but not .env or .venv (uv's default env dir)

parallel_agent_isolation.rationale: Library without services; tests use in-memory SQLite (sqlite://) and the OTLP test collector binds port 0

agent_readable_logs.rationale: Library; no local dev server or service logs to read

..rationale: Criterion skips libraries (as distributed_tracing and structured_logging do here); scanner matched a docstring in fastapi/telemetry/_api.py, though fastapi/telemetry/_asgi.py does redact sensitive query params in spans

secret_scanning.rationale: No gitleaks/trufflehog/detect-secrets in .pre-commit-config.yaml or workflows; platform setting not visible (security_and_analysis null, secret-scanning alerts API 404) (unverified)

..rationale: Library stores no personal data; SQL/user models exist only as docs_src tutorial examples

automated_security_review.rationale: GitHub CodeQL default setup (dynamic/github-code-scanning/codeql, 1,758 runs) analyzes python, actions and javascript-typescript on PRs, e.g. refs/pull/16641/head and the Analyze (python) check on #16642; zizmor covers workflows

agent_config_reviewed.rationale: Agent-facing instructions exist (fastapi/.agents/skills/ shipped to users, 14 llm-prompt.md files steering the scheduled translation agent) but there is no CODEOWNERS and the master ruleset requires 0 approvals

agent_guardrails_config.rationale: No .claude/settings.json, .codex/config.toml, .cursor/ or Copilot firewall config; nothing keeps agents out of secrets

agent_hooks.rationale: No agent hooks; ruff/mypy/ty only run via pre-commit (prek) if the agent commits or remembers

issue_templates.rationale: Only .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/privileged.yml (one free-form 'Issue Content' box for maintainers) plus config.yml links; no repro or acceptance-criteria fields. The bug-report repro form lives in DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE/questions.yml, not issues

backlog_health.rationale: Tracker is kept clear: the only open issue is pinned Roadmap #10370 (5.2k-char body, updated 2026-06); the last 30 closed issues were resolved (25 completed, 3 not planned, 2 duplicate) and requests are routed to Discussions

plans_in_repo.rationale: No plans/, specs, ADRs or progress files; the roadmap lives only in GitHub issue #10370

error_to_insight_pipeline.rationale: No automation turns Discussions feedback or errors into issues; add-to-project.yml only files existing issues/PRs into a project board

action_items.title: Add an AGENTS.md with dev commands and conventions
action_items.why: The only in-repo contributing doc is a 7-line link to tiangolo.com, so agents reverse-engineer setup from CI YAML; the same gap fails single_test_command, single_command_setup and naming_consistency at Level 2
action_items.how: Commit a <200-line AGENTS.md giving `uv sync` + `prek install` as the bootstrap, `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/test.sh tests/test_x.py::test_y`, `bash scripts/lint.sh`/`format.sh`, the 100% coverage gate, the docs_src/tests/test_tutorial pairing and naming rules

action_items.title: Add a pull request template
action_items.why: PRs need an emoji-prefixed title and a label for the required latest-changes/label check, and regression-test proof is checked in CI, but nothing tells an agent before it opens a PR
action_items.how: Add .github/pull_request_template.md with title format, label, regression test and docs_src example checklist

action_items.title: Add CODEOWNERS covering code and agent prompts
action_items.why: No path ownership and the master ruleset needs 0 approvals, so changes to fastapi/, docs/<lang>/ and the agent prompts (fastapi/.agents/, docs/*/llm-prompt.md) have no designated reviewer; also fails agent_config_reviewed at Level 3
action_items.how: Add .github/CODEOWNERS with a `*` maintainer default plus entries for fastapi/.agents/, scripts/general-llm-prompt.md and docs/*/llm-prompt.md
